University of Copenhagen, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences | 2021 to 2022
Instructor in biostatistics and epidemiology for 3rd semester MSc Medicine students (5 ECTS, ca. 20 students per class, 2 hours weekly). Directed practical case-based teaching covering hypothesis testing, linear and logistic regression, survival analysis, and statistical data analysis in R.




Bispebjerg and Frederiksberg Hospital | 2021 to 2023
Co-organizer and instructor for acute hospital physicians and junior doctors (ca. 50 participants per course, held 4 times per semester). Covered applied pharmacokinetics, therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM), drug-drug interactions, and management of acute intoxications.




University of Copenhagen & Bispebjerg Hospital | 2021 to 2025
Annual lecture and practical seminar for clinical researchers and PhD students on using Danish nationwide health registries (LPR2, LPR3, Lægemiddelstatistikregisteret, CPR) for pharmacoepidemiology and observational research (ca. 20 participants).




University of Copenhagen, Department of Computer Science | 2020 to 2021
Invited lecturer for postgraduate students and researchers on health data structures, electronic health records, and clinical data governance (ca. 50 participants per year).




University of Copenhagen, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences | 2008 to 2015
Lectures on medical IT systems, clinical databases, and informatics for 1st semester undergraduate medical students (ca. 150 to 200 students per semester).

Cardiovascular Pharmacogenetics & Biobank Linkage


Principal Investigator


Deterministic individual-level linkage across Danish nationwide health registries and the Copenhagen Hospital Biobank (CHB) evaluating clinical outcomes associated with CYP2C19 loss-of-function variants in antiplatelet therapy, SLCO1B1-mediated statin uptake, and bedside clinical decision support.


2025






SAMSON-2 Trial


Sponsor & Principal Investigator


Investigator-initiated, nationwide, 11-center randomized controlled trial comparing a digital double-blind N-of-1 trial platform against guideline-directed standard care titration to systematically differentiate statin-associated muscle symptoms from expectation bias. Funded by the Capital Region of Denmark, Bispebjerg Hospital, and Hørslev-Fonden.


2024






TDM-VISION


Principal Investigator


Prospective clinical research project evaluating therapeutic drug monitoring algorithms and pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic exposure metrics for targeted oral therapies (ibrutinib and venetoclax) in chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Funded by the Danish Cancer Society (DKK 2.3M).


2024






SPOCK Trial & European PGx Consortia


Co-investigator & Work Package Collaborator


Multinational European clopidogrel pharmacogenomics consortium (1,200 patients) investigating CYP2C19 genotype-guided therapy, alongside active working group participation in COST Action CardioPharmGeneNet and CPIC guideline development.

I am a clinical pharmacologist and physician-researcher investigating how precision pharmacotherapy and pharmacogenetics improve patient outcomes. My research program bridges prospective randomized clinical trials, nationwide Danish health registries, and clinical implementation to establish pharmacological causality and optimize drug safety.
I serve as Sponsor and Principal Investigator for the nationwide SAMSON-2 trial, establishing an N-of-1 trial platform to systematically evaluate statin-associated muscle symptoms and overcome drug intolerance. In parallel, I lead the TDM-VISION project, establishing therapeutic drug monitoring algorithms for targeted oral oncolytics in chronic lymphocytic leukemia.
